title: Idea priority queue
description: The idea priority file. A plain ordered list of idea ids that jump the queue, sitting beside the append-only idea log rather than inside it — the same shape as the backlog's next_up. Reordering is a hand-edited operational decision, not a logged event: version-control history is the audit trail. Every listed idea must exist in the log and be open or triaged; that cross-file check is the ideas check's, not this schema's.

updated.description: Date this file was last reordered. Must not be in the future.

next_up.description: Idea ids that jump the queue, in order. Everything else falls back to status (open before triaged) then id.
